title.value: The default mode network in cognition: a topographical perspective
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned multiple times in the paper.
title.quote: The default mode network in cognition: a topographical perspective

analysis.description: This paper discusses the default mode network (DMN) in the brain, exploring its topographical characteristics and its role in various cognitive functions. The study considers how the DMN's location in the brain contributes to its involvement in complex cognitive processes and its functional connectivity with other networks during both resting states and task performance.

type.justification: The paper primarily explores concepts, theories, and implications of the DMN in cognition without empirical experiments or novel data analysis.
type.quote: This Perspective considers the diverse roles that the DMN plays in cognition in the context of recent observations regarding its spatial location on the cortical mantle.

name.justification: The paper explores the brain's neural networks, specifically the default mode network, from a cognitive neuroscience perspective.
name.quote: The goal of cognitive neuroscience is to understand the physical substrates of cognition.

name.justification: The paper delves into the functional connectivity of brain regions that constitute the DMN, analyzing its role in cognition and behavior.
name.quote: Research assessing the functional connectivity of brain regions, a metric calculated based on the temporal correlation between neural activity in different regions of the brain, demonstrated that DMN regions show coordinated temporal activity at rest.
